correctness.rationale: For every \(m,n\ge2\) over C, Chebyshev identity gives \(u^2=f^2h\). The finite birational ring \(B=A[w]/(w^2-h)\) is S2 and normal because its only singularities are four isolated A1 points. Direct A-module multiplication gives conductor \((f,u)\) and \(B/R=A/(f)\). Chebyshev simple roots exhaust the four formal types; their exact Jacobian ideals give a length-one embedded excess precisely at every pinch and crossing. The intrinsic component intersection graph \(K_{m-1,n-1}\) proves isomorphism classification. Included exact finite SymPy checks passed; proof does not depend on experiments.
